description: X-tee teenuste monitooringu avaandmed is a dataset listed in Data information gateway, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Riigi Infosüsteemi Amet. X-Road services monitoring data is collected from the Estonian X-Road members' security servers available to the Estonian Information System Authority and published as open data with a 10-day reference to the actual time of the query. The time of inquiry (requestInTs) is rounded to the accuracy of the hour, presented as Unix time (epoch time). Coverage: Riigi Infosüsteemi Amet. The portal shows the English title as "X-Road services monitoring open data" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Riigi Infosüsteemi Amet. Its keywords include elektronandmevahetus, data communication, EDI, andmeside. The listing shows 3 download or service links in JSON. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-avaandmete-portaal.
